notes: Harmonization stage: derives the NSRR harmonized variables (nsrr_age, nsrr_age_gt89, nsrr_sex, nsrr_race, nsrr_ethnicity, nsrr_bmi, nsrr_bmipct, nsrr_bp_systolic, nsrr_bp_diastolic) by recoding PCORI gender/race/hispanic codes to human-readable labels and dividing age-in-days by 365.25. The nchsdb_nsrr input built inline (one row tuned to 90+ years so the age_gt89 branch is exercised); the recode logic, FORMAT statements, and KEEP list are unchanged.
